title: Campaign Decisions
record_unit: One campaign contact, not a unique person across campaigns
business_context: A fictional retailer wants to assess campaign targeting and contact costs. Explore useful comparisons before recommending how managers should allocate attention and budget.
learner_profile: Business-school introductory analytics students with limited programming experience.
ai_policy: AI tools are allowed throughout. You remain responsible for your data handling, evidence, and conclusions.

learning_objectives.description: Frame useful business questions and explain the comparisons selected.
Guide AI exploration and verify the calculations supporting a finding.
Communicate evidence-based recommendations and distinguish observations from causal hypotheses.

columns.name: Converted
columns.description: Whether the contact resulted in a purchase

columns.name: ContactCost
columns.description: Allocated campaign cost for this contact

columns.name: PurchaseValue
columns.description: Purchase value; zero when there is no conversion

patterns.title: Email conversion differs by relationship segment
patterns.business_question: Should Email targeting distinguish new and existing relationships?
patterns.generation_rule: Set separate Email conversion probabilities by relationship segment.
patterns.interaction_policy: Other channels use the same baseline probability; this is a conditional effect, not an overall customer-quality claim.
patterns.interpretation_limits: Campaign contact outcomes do not identify the causal effect of targeting or long-term customer value.

patterns.title: Contact cost differs by channel
patterns.business_question: Which channels consume more allocated cost per contact?
patterns.interaction_policy: Contact cost and conversion use distinct rules; higher cost does not imply better return.
patterns.interpretation_limits: Per-contact cost alone cannot establish campaign profitability or the best allocation.

checks.description: Conversion-share difference: existing minus new contacts within Email
Mean contact cost difference in USD: Search minus Email

requirements: Present at least three suitable visualizations and explain the comparison supporting each finding.
Write a management recommendation of at most 180 words.
Retain your analysis and describe one numerical check of an AI-generated claim.

criteria.name: Analytical evidence
criteria.description: Full credit requires the case's major relationships, correct comparisons and denominators, and reproducible evidence. Award proportional credit for independently supported partial findings; unsupported claims earn no discovery credit.

criteria.name: Business interpretation
criteria.description: Recommendations follow the evidence, acknowledge unmeasured explanations, and explain business relevance. Reduce credit for unsupported mechanisms or irrelevant recommendations.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Charts are appropriate, clearly labeled, and accompanied by concise interpretations that meet the assignment requirements. Award partial credit according to clarity and completeness.

notes: Count duplicate conclusions once, even when visualized differently.
Review valid unlisted findings on their evidence and relevance; they are not automatically false positives.
The key is not exhaustive. These proposed descriptors require instructor review before actual grading.
